verdict.rationale: WooCommerce can be driven without its dashboard. An official WC-CLI manages stores from the command line. The REST API supports full JSON CRUD with scoped API keys and has official JS/PHP/Python/Ruby libraries. A Store API serves headless storefronts, and webhooks handle event-driven automation. Missing for 10: documentation on running in CI (e.g. containerized/ephemeral store setup or non-interactive pipeline recipes) and independent or hands-on confirmation of headless/CI use.
